text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the Yasuda Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's enthusiasm for her
training
only grows the closer we get to
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 'Course I am! I'm in top form!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've never been more on fire than I am
right now,
but that's no surprise!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After all, Oguri's the strongest racer
there is!
There's no way I can beat her
unless I push past
my limits and train till
I drop!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't be afraid to turn the heat up to
eleven,
Trainer! I'm not even starting to
feel tired yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her unwavering optimism leaves me in
stunned
admiration. And she's
right—Oguri Cap's about as
tough as an
opponent can get, and we'll have to

train hard to defeat her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm talking about!
choice_data_list: We're going to blaze even hotter!
We're going to blaze even hotter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I've got to make sure to thank
Oguri! If it
wasn't for her, I would never
have been able to
get so fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I think I know how to talk to Yaeno! And
not just
through my running—I think I
can put it into
words too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited to see Oguri win today! It
never
gets old!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Will we be able to see Oguri from here,
Daddy?
Can you take a picture when she
crosses the finish
line?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Show everyone you're the best at miles
too,
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the Yasuda Kinen to
start. I
can't believe Bamboo and Yaeno
are running with
Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
After today's race, you, Yaeno, and I
ought to
know where we stand in this
generation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Bamboo will be able to show
us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I believe that she will reveal to
us today
what we lost sight of long ago.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's have a good race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... She has an even more oppressive
aura than
before.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Just how much stronger has she gotten?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! Oguri's in tip-top form today!
Dang, I
didn't expect anything less from
her, but still!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're not scared, Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's definitely putting out some
pretty
scary vibes, but that's how you
know she's the real
deal!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a great race today, Yaeno! I'm
going to
give you a race you won't soon
forget!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'm gonna go say hi to Oguri
too. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo, wai—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to running
with you
fooooorrrever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But I'm here to win, so I'm going to
throw
everything I've got into this race!
Let's have a
great race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm looking forward to it. And
don't worry,
I'm throwing my all into this
race too. Let's do our
best.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
All right!
